## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Describe the situation in which you
wished PortPilot did something it doesn't currently do.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see PortPilot do. UI sketches, mockups, or screenshots
of similar features in other tools are welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've thought about, and why they're less ideal.

## Additional context

Anything else worth knowing — links to related issues, similar tools,
relevant docs.
